source: STAR'13 Theorem 8 / Corollary 9 / Corollary 12 (permutation-invariant = unlabeled MPP, Problem 2). Not in ICRA'13 or TOR'16 (TOR only cites [17] for 'polynomial time' unlabeled results).
statement: ell = max_{u in xI(A), v in xG(A)} dist(u,v); a time-expanded network with T = n + ell - 1 is 'necessary and sufficient' for a feasible solution to exist.
abstract_variant: abstract/intro: finish time no more than n + V - 1 (uses ell <= V; actually ell <= V - 1)

tight_family.graph: hub h with n start leaves, corridor h - c1 - ... - cL - h2, h2 with n goal leaves
tight_family.claim: unlabeled min makespan == n + ell - 1 (bound attained)

random_property_test.expect: unlabeled min makespan <= n + ell - 1 on every instance

finding: The bound is a sufficient, worst-case-tight horizon, not a necessary one for a given instance ('necessary and sufficient' is an overstatement).
